Question Choices: Which values of x make this true? |x| > 7. Choose from -9, 4, 6
Hints: Absolute value is nonnegative. Test each offered value and respect the strict inequality.
Solution: |-9| = 9 passes; |4| = 4 fails; |6| = 6 fails. A value equal to 7 fails the strict inequality. Select -9.

Question Choices: Jane: -6 lb, Sarah: +3 lb, Bill: +7 lb. Who had the largest change in weight?
Hints: The sign gives gain or loss; absolute value gives the size of the change.
Solution: Jane, Sarah and Bill have changes -6 lb, 3 lb, 7 lb. Their change sizes are 6 lb, 3 lb, 7 lb. Bill has the greatest magnitude, 7 lb.

Question Choices: Select True or False of the statement "|x| > -14 is true for every number x." ~~True | False~~
Hints: Absolute value is nonnegative. Test each offered value and respect the strict inequality.
Solution: For every real number x, |x| ≥ 0. Since 0 > -14, every possible absolute value is greater than -14. This includes x = 0. Answer: True.
